comparison.objective: Break open an inert scored ampoule using a protective opener while retaining the cap and keeping the body upright.
comparison.physical_skill: Protective-tool alignment, controlled breakaway torque, fragment/cap capture, and safe release.
comparison.success_condition: Native neck joint breaks, cap remains fully captured, body returns upright to its holder, opener returns to its rack, and both remain released and still; neck/cap contact, excessive tilt, escape, or drop forces zero.
comparison.reason: This tests controlled fracture and captive retention; prototype break-force calibration is explicitly missing, but the objective and tested ability remain clearly different from threaded stop adjustment and lock verification.
